data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the hare can be seen as a symbol of renewal and resurrection because of its ability to reproduce quickly and in large numbers. The Christian poet George Herbert wrote a poem titled "The Hare," which describes the hare as a reminder of the resurrection of Jesus Christ. Additionally, the hare's association with the moon reflects the Christian belief in the influence of the moon on the tides and on human emotions and behavior.
